title: System Predicts Autonomous Vehicle AI Mistakes
summary: A new method called CW-Net translates an autonomous vehicle AI's reasoning process into understandable concepts to explain its behavior.

title: Relativity Creates Drag for Interstellar Solar Sails
summary: At about 75 percent of the speed of light, scattered photons can begin creating drag against laser-pushed solar sails.

title: Anritsu Launches Wideband Linear Amplifier for Optical Comms
summary: Anritsu is launching the AH15203A/B 140 Gbaud wideband linear amplifier with integrated bias tee for optical communications developers.

title: First Section of Saltley Viaduct Installed for HS2
summary: HS2 engineers successfully installed the first 55-meter section of the new Saltley Viaduct over the Birmingham to Derby railway lines.

title: SprintRay Launches Ceramic-Filled Resin
summary: SprintRay released Midas Restore, a ceramic-filled resin supporting crowns, veneers, inlays, and onlays with a four-minute post-curing workflow.

title: Addionics Develops 3D Porous Battery Architecture
summary: Addionics designed a battery architecture using 3D porous current collectors to improve ion transport and performance in cold conditions.

title: Researchers Quantum Teleport Data Across 100 Channels
summary: Researchers in China scaled quantum teleportation up to 100 simultaneous channels using a spatial light modulator and entangled light fields.

title: West Midlands Metro Opens New Control Centre
summary: West Midlands Metro has opened a new Operational Control Centre at its Wednesbury depot ahead of an upcoming extension launch.

title: Flat Optical Fibers Developed for Ultra-Sensitive Sensing
summary: Scientists have developed flat optical fiber sensor technology that outperforms traditional round optical fibers.

title: Teradyne Launches Instruments for UltraFLEXplus
summary: Teradyne released three new instruments to support the testing of AI and data center chips.

title: Pudu Robotics Launches GT Series Commercial Robotic Mowers
summary: Pudu Robotics introduced three new commercial robotic mower models targeted at grounds maintenance and large turf areas.

title: Marr Cranes Complete Flue Gas Stack Installation
summary: Marr Contracting cranes successfully installed a modularised 100m chimney stack at the North London Heat and Power Project.

title: Startup HrdWyr Develops AI-Native SoCs
summary: Indian startup HrdWyr is building AI-native SoCs designed for power management, motor control, and physical system applications.

title: Bonnell Launches 805 RX Electric Dirt Bike
summary: Bonnell launched its new 805 RX electric dirt bike, featuring 56 horsepower and an 80-mph top speed.

title: Scientists Trace Seven Stages of Meteorite Life
summary: By studying 75 fallen meteorites, scientists identified the seven stages a space rock undergoes entering Earth's atmosphere.

title: Launch Site Progress Ahead of Starship East Coast Debut
summary: SpaceX is making facility progress at its launch site in Florida ahead of upcoming Starship flights.

title: Robust Optimal Control via Generalized Semi-Infinite Programming
summary: Researchers present a general framework that reformulates generalized semi-infinite programs to solve robust optimal control problems with state-dependent uncertainty.

title: Behavior Architecture System for Humanoid Robots
summary: A runtime-editable behavior authoring system enables humanoid robots to rapidly coordinate perception, locomotion, and whole-body manipulation tasks.

title: Visko Launches Orbis Live Model
summary: Visko launched its Orbis model that streams 4K video at 24 frames per second and closed a pre-seed funding round.

title: Evaluating Temporal Robustness in Imitation Learning
summary: A study comparing expert and imitation-learned dexterous manipulation policies reveals that equal nominal task success does not preserve performance across execution speeds.

title: Vision-Based Formation Control for UAVs
summary: A vision-based cooperative framework enables follower UAVs to maintain formation using an onboard RGB-D camera when GPS sensors degrade or fail.

title: Blackbox Modeling of Inverters in Asymmetrical Grids
summary: A new sequence domain structure models the dynamic behavior of grid-connected commercial inverters during asymmetrical voltage sag conditions.

title: Evaluating MLLMs as Vision-Language-Action Drone Agents
summary: A new benchmark tests multimodal large language models as generalist drone control agents, revealing challenges in sustaining action protocols and terminating tasks.

title: Autonomous Robotic Aquatic Bridging with Swarm Control
summary: Unmanned surface vehicles use distributed swarm control and multi-model sensing to autonomously form bridges without requiring GPS or RF communications.

title: Unified ROS 2 Architecture for Outdoor Robots
summary: A unified ROS 2 architecture combines coverage planning, RTK-GNSS localization, and navigation to achieve reliable autonomous outdoor coverage missions.

title: Satellite Swarms for Direct-to-Cell Networks
summary: This work investigates 2D distributed satellite swarm configurations for direct-to-cell applications to exploit increased spatial resolution from large distributed apertures.

title: £27M Thelwall Viaduct Upgrades Begin
summary: Work has started on critical improvements and joint replacements for the Thelwall Viaduct on the M6.

title: Ice Dart Quadcopter Lands on Vertical Ice Walls
summary: Researchers at the Université de Sherbrooke developed a cat-clawed drone capable of landing on near-vertical ice walls.

title: U.S. Navy Funds Phase II for UAV Composites
summary: The U.S. Navy has funded a 30-month R&D program and a one-year option for embedded-power UAV composites.

title: ScottishPower Wind Farm Decommissioning Demonstrates Circularity
summary: Decommissioning Scotland's first commercial wind farm has demonstrated how the wind sector can align with material reuse.
